# P37.43 — Search result export

Row 467 of 510 · `R11-K13-SRCH-08` (K3 SRCH-08) · sub-round 11D ·
`implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/467_P37.43__search-result-export.md live_verification=false` ·
gate `none` · not an OM-20 row.

**CSV/JSON download of a search result set (≤ 10,000 rows), per licence
group with licence files (J3 TX download conventions).**

`GET /v1/releases/{pub or latest}/search/export?format=csv|json` answers a
deterministic `application/zip` bundle over the same verified
`sig.search-results/2` engine the federated route serves:

- one folder **per licence group** — `<comp>/results.csv` (ADR-224
  `#`-comment licence preamble) or `<comp>/results.json`
  (`sig.search-export-records/1`) beside `<comp>/LICENCE.txt` and
  `<comp>/ATTRIBUTION.txt`; a licence group's rows never share a file
  with another group's, and every row carries its licence column;
- `manifest.json` (`sig.search-export/1`) — release, query, scope
  (access-time denials counted, DR-C4-09), the 10,000-row cap and the
  honest `truncated` flags; `README.txt`; `SHA256SUMS`;
- `SearchEngineV2.export_records` — the same match-quality order and
  denial barrier as the page (denied rows never export), collapsed
  acronym word-hits withheld, per-group exact `total` beside
  `exported`/`truncated`, suggestion re-runs enumerate the corrected
  tokens;
- same `SIG_API_SEARCH_V2` dark-ship posture, engine LRU, cache contract
  (immutable pub-pinned / 300 `latest`) and no-query-logging posture as
  `/search`; the T0 no-JS results page gains "Download these results"
  links per licence group plus all-groups CSV/JSON.
